b6_reason: A matches NCERT exactly: pollen released from microsporangium, carried by air currents. R is wrong because gymnosperms are siphonogamous: a pollen tube IS formed to deliver the male gametes to the egg near the archegonium; air currents only carry pollen to the micropyle/ovule, not directly to the archegonia mouth.
